name: phase_shape
summary: Vector phaseshaping (VPS, DAFx-11 — Kleimola/Lazzarini/Timoney/Välimäki): one 2-D inflection point p=(d,v) reshapes the phase ramp piecewise-linearly before the wave read. `d` = the breakpoint's x-coordinate (0..1); `v` = its y-coordinate, which may go outside [0,1] — the shaped phase then wraps (uint32). Classic phase distortion is the v=0.5 case (`phase_dist`). Both `d` and `v` are control-rate (the slopes are block_derived).
